added.description:
At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.

What You'll Do

With the support of your team's tech lead and manager, you will break down larger projects into individual tasks, deliver them in multiple phases, and collaborate with others to ensure timely delivery of your work.
You will support your peers and stakeholders in the product development lifecycle by collaborating with product management, design & analytics by participating in ideation, articulating technical constraints, and partnering on decisions that properly consider risks and trade-offs.
You will support the operations and availability of your team's artifacts by creating and monitoring metrics, escalating when needed, and supporting "keep the lights on" & on-call efforts.
You will contribute to a sense of community on your team by engaging in growth and development activities such as participation in the interview process.

What We Look For

You have a total of 1.5+ years of experience as a software engineer.
You have experience shipping web apps using declarative UI frameworks like React or Vue
You have experience shipping mobile apps using native or cross-platform languages like React Native
You have experience designing, developing and launching APIs at scale using languages like Kotlin or Python.
You have mastered taking a simple problem or business scenario into a solution that interacts with multiple software components, and executing on it by writing clear, easily understood, well tested and extensible code.
You are comfortable navigating a large code base, debugging others' code, and providing feedback to other engineers through code reviews.
Your experience demonstrates that you take ownership of your growth, proactively seeking feedback from your team, your manager, and your stakeholders.
You have strong verbal and written communication skills that support effective collaboration with our global engineering team.
This position requires either equivalent practical experience or a Bachelor's degree in a related field.

- L

$165,000 - $225,000

Health coverage at no cost: We cover 100% of premiums for employees and their dependents.

added.title: Full Stack Engineer
added.description:
About the Role

Lori Vision Studio is building WowNow, a software-and-hardware platform connecting digital creation, commerce, and physical production through connected TimeForge devices. We are seeking a senior, hands-on engineer to own architecture and production delivery across customer-facing web applications, internal admin workflows, Android kiosk experiences, and the services that connect our platform to physical machines.
You will partner with the Technical Lead and Product, Design, Hardware, and Operations teams. You will lead technical design within your scope, make pragmatic architecture decisions, mentor engineers through code reviews, and be accountable for system quality, reliability, and release outcomes. This is an application/software engineering role, not a mechanical, electrical, firmware, or Android OS-driver position.

What You Will Own

Lead architecture, implementation, testing, and production operation of customer WebApp features using React and TypeScript; define maintainable component, state, authentication, and data-access patterns.
Own integration across WebApp, admin tools (currently Vue 3), backend APIs, order and production workflows, and device-facing applications; make clear tradeoffs and document architecture decisions.
Design robust Android kiosk application experiences using React Native/Expo or appropriate existing approaches, including offline/timeout/retry/recovery states, device APIs, observability, controlled OTA rollout, diagnostics, and rollback.
Design and implement reliable REST/gRPC services using existing Go or Node.js stacks; work with PostgreSQL, Redis, RabbitMQ, and MQTT/EMQX where relevant. Apply idempotency, acknowledgement, retry, deduplication, state transitions, and partial-failure recovery to device and order workflows.
Own production readiness: automated tests, CI/CD, Docker/Kubernetes deployment practices, health checks, logging/metrics, incident investigation, secure configuration, and operational runbooks; partner with platform owners on infrastructure rather than independently owning every infrastructure component.
Drive engineering quality through design reviews, code reviews, mentorship, pragmatic technical-debt reduction, and collaboration with product, design, hardware, and field operations.
As an initial priority, lead technical execution of the corporate website rebuild, including architecture selection, CMS integration/migration, technical SEO, analytics, redirects, accessibility, launch verification, and handoff. This is an initial project, not the long-term center of the role.

Required Qualifications

6+ years of professional software engineering experience, including 3+ years owning complex, production-grade features or systems from technical design through deployment and ongoing support; equivalent demonstrable experience considered.
Deep production experience with React, TypeScript/JavaScript, modern frontend architecture, browser performance, accessibility, and secure authentication/authorization patterns.
Demonstrated full-stack ownership: designing APIs, working with relational databases, managing data integrity, debugging distributed failures, and delivering production releases.
Strong proficiency in at least one production backend stack (Go or Node.js preferred), plus ability to work effectively in an unfamiliar codebase.
Experience designing reliable asynchronous or event-driven integrations, including retries, idempotency, observability, and recovery from partial failures.
Practical production experience with testing, Git/code review, CI/CD, containers, deployment and rollback; able to diagnose live incidents and communicate risk.
Evidence of senior-level technical judgment: architecture proposals, cross-team technical leadership, maintainable design decisions, mentorship, and independent problem-solving.
Able to work with physical test devices at our Ontario location when integration or troubleshooting requires it, with or without reasonable accommodation.

Strongly Preferred

Production experience with Android kiosks, React Native/Expo, device APIs, MDM/ADB, OTA updates, or connected IoT products.
Experience with order/payment/fulfillment or hardware-integrated workflows, and reliable machine-to-cloud communication.
Vue 3/Pinia; Go/go-zero/gRPC; PostgreSQL/PostGIS; Redis; RabbitMQ; MQTT/EMQX.
AWS, Kubernetes, Helm, Argo CD, GitOps, and production observability.
WordPress engineering or Next.js/headless CMS; technical SEO and high-stakes website migrations.

Technology Landscape

Customer: React, TypeScript, Vite, TanStack Router/Query, Zustand, Tailwind CSS, HeroUI. Admin: Vue 3, Pinia, Vben/Naive UI. Kiosk: React Native, Expo, Android. Services: Go/go-zero, Node.js/Fastify, REST, gRPC, SSE. Data/messaging: PostgreSQL/PostGIS, Redis, RabbitMQ, EMQX/MQTT. Delivery: Docker, Kubernetes, Helm, Argo CD, Kuboard, AWS. Familiarity with every tool is not required.

Success in the Role

First 30 days:
Understand system architecture and device workflows; identify top reliability risks; ship a reviewed production improvement; propose a website migration and measurement plan.
First 90 days:
Lead delivery of a meaningful end-to-end product or device integration; reach an agreed website launch milestone; implement measurable reliability/diagnostic improvements and document operational handoffs.
First 6 months:
Own a critical product/device software domain; improve agreed release-quality and reliability metrics; mentor peers; establish repeatable architecture, incident-response, and deployment practices.

The Opportunity

Adobe is seeking dedicated and curious Software Engineer interns to help design, build, and evolve the systems that power our products and platforms.

As an intern, you’ll work in an AI-enabled development environment, where modern tools accelerate how software is built and tested. You’ll collaborate with experienced engineers and multi-functional partners, including designers and product managers, to contribute to real-world systems while continuing to build your technical and problem-solving skills.

Software engineering opportunities at Adobe span a broad range of products, technologies, and technical problem spaces. Whether you're passionate about creating intuitive user experiences, building scalable systems, or solving complex engineering challenges, we'll consider your technical skills, interests, and team needs when identifying the best opportunity within our engineering organization.

This role is designed for early-career engineers who are excited not only about writing code, but also about understanding how software works end-to-end, validating solutions, and connecting technical decisions to real user and product outcomes.

All 2027 Adobe interns will be co-located hybrid. This means that interns will work between their assigned office and home. Interns will be based in the office where their manager and/or team are located, where they will get the most support to ensure collaboration and the best employee experience. Managers and their organization will determine the frequency they need to go into the office to meet priorities.

What You’ll Do

Develop high-quality, reliable, testable, and maintainable code using modern engineering practices
Contribute to all phases of the software development lifecycle, including design, implementation, testing, debugging, and documentation
Work with AI-assisted development tools to support coding, testing, and debugging, while learning how to validate outputs for correctness and quality
Review and improve code ensuring performance, scalability, and maintainability
Collaborate with engineers through stand-ups, code reviews, and design discussions
Contribute to solution design and help improve product quality, reliability, and performance with guidance from experienced engineers
Solve issues, debug problems, and iterate on solutions in a fast-paced environment
Communicate clearly and effectively with teammates, sharing ideas, asking questions, and incorporating feedback
Grow your technical and professional skills while contributing to a positive, inclusive engineering culture

Enrolled in a Bachelor’s or Master’s academic program in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field, with graduation between December 2027 - June 2028
Strong foundation in software engineering fundamentals, including data structures, algorithms, and coding principles
Experience through coursework, personal projects, or internships building applications or systems

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to debug and reason through technical challenges
Ability to learn quickly, adapt to new technologies, and take initiative in solving problems
Clear communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively within a team
Ability to participate in a full-time internship between May-September

Adobe empowers everyone to create through innovative platforms and tools that unleash creativity, productivity and personalized customer experiences. Adobe’s industry-leading offerings including Adobe Acrobat Studio, Adobe Express, Adobe Firefly, Creative Cloud, Adobe Experience Platform, Adobe Experience Manager, and GenStudio enable people and businesses to turn ideas into impact, powered by AI and driven by human ingenuity.

Our 30,000+ employees worldwide are creating the future and raising the bar as we drive the next decade of growth. Learn more about Adobe life, including our values and culture, focus on people, purpose and community, Adobe for All, comprehensive benefits programs, the stories we tell, the customers we serve, and how you can help us advance our mission of empowering everyone to create.

You have the knowledge, now gain the experience!

Participate in code reviews, manage requirements, and utilize project tracking systems.

Sophomore, Junior, Senior standing in Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Software Engineering, Cybersecurity Engineering, or equivalent

Ability to work independently and as part of a team

SeatGeek believes live events are powerful experiences that unite humans. With our technological savvy and fan-first attitude we’re simplifying and modernizing the ticketing industry.

We’re building an awesome entertainment ecosystem where fans have effortless access to incredible live experiences, while sports teams, venues, and shows have unprecedented access to their audiences – because everyone should expect more from the ticketing industry.

Open roles for new graduates

We are looking for the best and brightest spring/summer of 2027 college graduates to help us make live entertainment even better! Experience is preferred, but not required – in fact, we look forward to supporting you by teaching you new technologies and mentoring you in software development craft as a member of our world-class engineering team.

We Have Roles Open In The Following Technologies

Backend (Python, Go, C#)
Frontend Web (Typescript + React)
Mobile (Kotlin, Swift)
Platform (AWS, Docker, Python, Go)
Machine Learning (PyTorch, lightGBM, LangChain, Strands)

What You'll Do

Solve unique and challenging customer problems
Work with leading-edge tech in the cloud or on web and mobile
Leverage cutting-edge AI tools to bring ideas to life faster than ever while upholding SeatGeek’s technical and product standards; no token limits
Help scale our software as we grow our booming business
Take on the challenges of building software for a many-sided marketplace
Empower decision-making at a rapidly growing data-driven company
Run experiments and evaluate new technologies that will determine the future of our business for years to come
Build performant, beautiful, inclusive user interfaces that delight our users and enhance our brand

What You Have

You are a college student graduating in the spring/summer of 2027, ideally in computer science or a related degree
Experience in building software. We'll be interested in hearing about what you've built and how you built it
Problem solving abilities, adept at handling technical challenges. SeatGeek engineers create custom solutions to unique ticketing problems, including venue mapping, inventory tracking, and event matching. We'll be excited to hear about the problems you've solved
Passion for software craftsmanship and product. You hold yourself and your code to a high standard
Commitment to your teammates. You enjoy working with a diverse group of people with different experiences and take pride in mentoring and learning from others

Our stack

Languages: Python, Go, C#+.NET Core, React+Typescript, Swift, Kotlin
Datastores: Postgres, Redis, Elasticsearch
Cloud: AWS
Version control: Gitlab

Perks

Equity stake
Discretionary annual bonus
A WFH stipend to support your home office setup
Unlimited PTO
Up to 16 weeks of fully-paid family leave
401(k) matching
Student loan matching program
Health, vision, dental, and life insurance
Up to $25k towards family building, reproductive health services and Gender-affirming care
$500 per year for wellness expenses
Subscriptions to Headspace (meditation), Headspace Care (therapy), and One Medical
$360 per quarter to spend on tickets to live events
Annual subscription to Spotify, Apple Music, or Amazon music
Please note you are expected to come into the SeatGeek New York City Office at least 3 days a week during your first year of employment**

added.description:
The Opportunity

Adobe is seeking hard-working and curious Software Engineers across all organizations to help design, build, and evolve the systems that power our products and platforms.

As a university graduate, you’ll work on real-world engineering problems across areas such as web, mobile, data, and platform development. You’ll collaborate with experienced engineers and partners from different functions, including designers and product managers. You will help build scalable systems and continue developing your technical skills and analytical thinking.

This role is designed for engineers who are excited not only about writing code, but also about understanding how software works end-to-end, validating solutions, and connecting technical decisions to real user and product outcomes.

What You’ll Do

Develop high-quality, reliable, testable, and maintainable code
Participate in all aspects of the software development lifecycle, including design, coding, code review, testing, debugging, deployment, and documentation
Use modern development tools, including AI-assisted tooling, to support coding, testing, debugging, and workflow efficiency, while ensuring quality, correctness, and sound technical judgment
Contribute to improving product quality, performance, scalability, and reliability with guidance from your team
Review and iterate on solutions, identifying issues, debugging problems, and refining implementations
Collaborate with engineers and multi-functional partners through stand-ups, code reviews, build discussions, and team meetings
Work both independently and collaboratively within a fast-paced development environment, communicating clearly and constructively
Learn from your team, seek feedback, and contribute to a positive and inclusive engineering culture
Additional responsibilities as needed based on specific role or team

What You Need To Succeed

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field, with an expected graduation date of December 2026 – June 2027
0-1+ years of experience through coursework, internships, research, or personal projects building applications or systems
Strong foundation in software engineering fundamentals, including data structures, algorithms, and coding principles
Proficiency in at least one programming language such as Java, Python, C++, or JavaScript
Familiarity with the software development lifecycle - designing, building, deploying, and maintaining applications
Exposure to or interest in modern development tools, including AI-assisted tools, and an understanding of how to use them responsibly
Strong analytical, debugging, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to reason through technical challenges
Ability to learn quickly, adapt to new technologies, and take initiative in solving problems
Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to clearly explain ideas and incorporate feedback
Customer-focused mindset and passion for building high-quality products and engineering excellence at scale

Adobe empowers everyone to create through innovative platforms and tools that unleash creativity, productivity and personalized customer experiences. Adobe’s industry-leading offerings including Adobe Acrobat Studio, Adobe Express, Adobe Firefly, Creative Cloud, Adobe Experience Platform, Adobe Experience Manager, and GenStudio enable people and businesses to turn ideas into impact, powered by AI and driven by human ingenuity.

At Adobe, we believe that great ideas can come from anywhere in the organization. The next big idea could be yours.

Let’s Adobe together

Learn more about Adobe life, including our values and culture, focus on people, purpose and community, Adobe for All, comprehensive benefits programs, the stories we tell, the customers we serve, and how you can help us advance our mission of empowering everyone to create.

added.description:
If you’re passionate about being part of a dynamic organization that enables a Fortune 100 company with nearly $70 billion in annual sales to drive innovation and adopt new technologies that deliver business results, then Nationwide’s Technology team could be the place for you! At Nationwide®, “on your side” goes beyond just words. Our customers are at the center of everything we do and we’re looking for associates who are passionate about delivering extraordinary care.

This role will work a hybrid schedule coming into the Des Moines, Iowa office.

This entry level position contributes to the development, maintenance, and support of Commercial Agribusiness applications and services. The associate will deliver defined software work with guidance from experienced team members, following established requirements, design direction, coding practices, security controls, and delivery processes. The team is a full-stack build-and-run team supporting applications and APIs used by members, agency partners, and internal associates.

Key Responsibilities

Implement, configure, test, debug, document, and maintain application code, APIs, and interfaces for assigned work. Break down defined tasks, raise questions when requirements or impacts are unclear, and communicate progress or risks to the team.
Learn the supported application landscape, data flows, and business processes. Develop working knowledge of the teams applications.
Contribute to application maintenance and modernization using technologies including Java, Spring Boot/Spring MVC, Angular, REST APIs, relational databases, CI/CD, and container platforms.

Desired background

A foundation in computer science, information systems, software development, or a related area is appropriate for the role. Relevant programming coursework or experience, basic understanding of the software development lifecycle, and willingness to learn team tools. Previous internship experience is valued.

Job Description Summary

If you’re enthusiastic about delivering secure technology solutions to support a company providing extraordinary care to its customers, then Nationwide Technology is the place for you. Nationwide's industry-leading technology workforce embraces an agile work environment and a collaborative culture to deliver outstanding solutions and results. If that sounds like something you aspire to, we want to hear from you!

As a Software Engineer, you will focus primarily on providing high-quality, efficient technology solutions to business partners by crafting new software applications or modifying and/or supporting existing packaged or custom-built applications. In this capacity, you’ll code, configure, test, debug, document, and maintain applications.

Job Description

Key Responsibilities:

Develop, test, debug, document, and deploy software according to engineering standards and best practices.
Apply secure software and systems engineering practices throughout the delivery lifecycle to ensure our data and technology solutions are protected from threats and vulnerabilities.
Use DevSecOps practices, tooling, and techniques.
Demonstrate continuous improvement and learning.
Review and process project priorities, deadlines, and deliverables proactively.

May Perform Other Responsibilities As Assigned.

Reporting Relationships:
Reports to a Technology Manager/Director.

Typical Skills And Experiences

Education
: Undergraduate studies in computer science, management information systems or other related degrees are preferred. Technology experience or non-traditional technology certificates can be substituted for an undergraduate degree.

Experience

added.description:
At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.

Search has become the default way consumers discover where to shop, compare options, and decide what to buy across platforms like Google, TikTok, and even Klarna. As we build a new Ads business and evolve Marketplace into a best in class shopping experience, improving search is one of our highest leverage investments to create an experience users choose and merchants want to invest in.

What You'll Do

With the support of your team, you will work on tasks that contribute to the team's projects and goals.
You will work collaboratively and proactively with your team and stakeholders, bringing them along for your work and helping to create visibility and dialog regarding the risks and trade-offs related to your work.
You will strike the right balance of speed and quality in your work, ensuring that we hit our business goals while protecting our systems from downtime.
You will contribute to a sense of community on your team by engaging in growth and development activities.

What We Look For

You have previous work or internship experience working with Javascript/Typescript.
You have previous work or internship experience designing, developing and launching backend systems at scale and are experienced using Python or Kotlin.
You have mastered taking a simple problem or business scenario into a solution that interacts with multiple software components, and executing on it by writing clear, easily understood, well tested and extensible code.
You are comfortable navigating a large code base, debugging others' code, and providing feedback to other engineers through code reviews.
Your experience demonstrates that you take ownership of your growth, proactively seeking feedback from your team, your manager, and your stakeholders.
You have strong verbal and written communication skills that support effective collaboration with our global engineering team.
This position requires either equivalent practical experience or a Bachelor’s degree in a related field.

Base Pay Grade
- J

Equity Grade
- 5

Employees new to Affirm typically come in at the start of the pay range. Affirm focuses on providing a simple and transparent pay structure which is based on a variety of factors, including location, experience and job-related skills.

$130,000 - $180,000

USA base pay range (all other U.S. states) per year:
$115,000 - $165,000

Remote-first with flexibility built in

Affirm is proud to be a remote-first company. Most roles can be done from almost anywhere within the country of employment. Some positions may occasionally require in-person work at an Affirm office, and a few are office-based due to the nature of the work. All new hires will be invited to attend an in-person onboarding experience.

Benefits Designed For You

Our benefits reflect our commitment to care, transparency, and flexibility. Here are a few highlights:

Health coverage at no cost: We cover 100% of premiums for employees and their dependents.
Spending stipends: Monthly stipends support your tech setup, and the ability to choose health and wellness options that are right for you.
Time off to recharge: Flexible time off and generous holiday calendars help you rest when you need to.

We’re committed to providing an inclusive interview process, including accommodations for candidates with disabilities. If you need support, we’re happy to help.

added.description:
Who Are We?

Taking care of our customers, our communities and each other. That’s the Travelers Promise. By honoring this commitment, we have maintained our reputation as one of the best property casualty insurers in the industry for over 170 years. Join us to discover a culture that is rooted in innovation and thrives on collaboration. Imagine loving what you do and where you do it.

Compensation Overview

The annual base salary range provided for this position is a nationwide market range and represents a broad range of salaries for this role across the country. The actual salary for this position will be determined by a number of factors, including the scope, complexity and location of the role; the skills, education, training, credentials and experience of the candidate; and other conditions of employment. As part of our comprehensive compensation and benefits program, employees are also eligible for performance-based cash incentive awards.

Salary Range

$72,200.00 - $119,000.00

Target Openings

50

What Is the Opportunity?

Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. now and in the future. The company does not sponsor/support H-1B petitions, TN, or Forms I-983/STEM OPT, for this role.

Applications for this posting will be reviewed on a rolling basis beginning in early September. We encourage you to apply as soon as possible

Innovative thinking, creative problem-solving, and a determination to challenge the status-quo, these are some of the defining qualities for participants of our Engineering Development Program (EDP). The EDP is a one-year program where you will be placed in one of the four designated Engineering tracks: Software, Data, Cybersecurity or Infrastructure & Cloud. Each track is designed to grow and develop your technical and self-leadership skills. Within your assigned track, you will receive a combination of hands-on opportunities, an immersive learning journey, and a mentoring program to prepare you for a dynamic career. You will have the opportunity to explore multiple technologies while learning from different engineers within Travelers.

Our five-week long technical learning accelerator consists of a mix of classroom, independent, and hands-on learning that is designed to fine-tune your skills and introduce you to Travelers technology. The accelerator focuses on providing you valuable training on multiple tools and technologies, but from a Travelers perspective. You will also learn about our software development lifecycle, enterprise engineering environments, artificial intelligence-enhanced practices, and working with Agile methodologies.

As an EDP participant, you will model the way for others and set a personal example of what is expected. You will positively challenge processes, embrace change, actively listen to and support diverse points of view, and celebrate the success of others. Travelers offers a hybrid work location model designed to support flexibility.

You are a self-starter who goes beyond required job or educational commitments to explore new technologies, applications, and environments. You take strong ownership of your actions, performance, and outcomes, proactively managing your time while juggling multiple projects simultaneously. You collaborate effectively and maintain a positive attitude whether working independently or as part of a team. You also demonstrate strong analytical aptitude—identifying current or future problems and opportunities, synthesizing and comparing data, recognizing cause-and-effect relationships, and exploring alternative solutions to support sound decision-making.

What Will You Do?

Travelers’ Software Engineers contribute to the overall software design strategy by planning, developing, debugging, testing, troubleshooting, documenting, and implementing software solutions that enable our products, distribution workflows, customer, agent, and employee experiences.
EDP participants in this track will have duties that vary based on the specific opportunities presented within each experience. These experiences include leveraging modern software engineering and analytic tools and practices, design, deliver, and support state-of-the-art and high performing infrastructure platforms and services enabling business operations and technology solutions. You will leverage modern analytical and artificial intelligence (AI) tools/platforms, applying critical thinking to evaluate the limitations, quality, and accuracy of AI-assisted outputs.
Additional program components include mentoring, networking, and career guidance.
Please note that occasional travel for business meetings and events is an expectation of program participants.
Perform other duties as assigned.

What Will Our Ideal Candidate Have?

Cumulative GPA of 3.0 or greater preferred.
Suggested majors include (but not limited to): Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering or a related discipline.
Exposure to object-oriented programming (OOP) in one or more major languages.
Experience with algorithms, data structures, systems design, and networking.
Knowledge of APIs and Web Development i.e. use of RESTful APIs, GraphQL, Eventing and modern front-end technologies such as React, NextJS, etc.
Familiarity with relational databases and SQL, as well as an awareness of NoSQL/document database concepts.

What is a Must Have?

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree or completion of licensed/accredited technical bootcamp.

What Is in It for You?

Health Insurance: Employees and their eligible family members – including spouses, domestic partners, and children – are eligible for coverage from the first day of employment.
Retirement: Travelers matches your 401(k) contributions dollar-for-dollar up to your first 5% of eligible pay, subject to an annual maximum. If you have student loan debt, you can enroll in the Paying it Forward Savings Program. When you make a payment toward your student loan, Travelers will make an annual contribution into your 401(k) account. You are also eligible for a Pension Plan that is 100% funded by Travelers.
Paid Time Off: Start your career at Travelers with a minimum of 20 days Paid Time Off annually, plus nine paid company Holidays.
Wellness Program: The Travelers wellness program is comprised of tools, discounts and resources that empower you to achieve your wellness goals and caregiving needs. In addition, our mental health program provides access to free professional counseling services, health coaching and other resources to support your daily life needs.
Volunteer Encouragement: We have a deep commitment to the communities we serve and encourage our employees to get involved. Travelers has a Matching Gift and Volunteer Rewards program that enables you to give back to the charity of your choice.

Employment Practices

Travelers is an equal opportunity employer. We value the unique abilities and talents each individual brings to our organization and recognize that we benefit in numerous ways from our differences.

In accordance with local law, candidates seeking employment in Colorado are not required to disclose dates of attendance at or graduation from educational institutions.

If you are a candidate and have specific questions regarding the physical requirements of this role, please send us an email so we may assist you.

Travelers reserves the right to fill this position at a level above or below the level included in this posting.

To learn more about our comprehensive benefit programs please visit http://careers.travelers.com/life-at-travelers/benefits/.

added.title: 2027 University Graduate - Machine Learning Engineer
added.description:
The Opportunity

Adobe is looking for a Machine Learning Engineer who will apply AI and machine learning techniques to big-data problems to help Adobe better understand, lead and optimize the experience of its customers. Partnering with the business units, the candidate will be building various products that address challenging business problems through our customers’ full lifecycle, from customer analytics to marketing media optimization.

By using statistical and econometric methods, predictive models, experimental design methods, and optimization techniques, the candidate will be working on the research and development of exciting projects like attribution, media mix modeling, budget optimization, personalization, causal analysis, time series analysis.

Ideal candidates will have a strong academic background as well as technical skills including applied statistics, machine learning, data mining, and software development. Familiarity with working with large-scale datasets and big data techniques would be a plus.

What You’ll Do

Develop predictive models on large-scale datasets to address various business problems with advanced statistical modeling, machine learning, and analytics techniques.
Develop and implement scalable and efficient modeling algorithms that can work with large-scale data in production systems
Collaborate with product management and engineering groups to develop new products and features.

What You Need to Succeed

PhD or MS in Computer Science, Statistics, Electrical Engineering, Applied Math, Operations Research, Econometrics or equivalent experience required with an expected graduation date of December 2026 – June 2027
0-2+ years of experience in specific relevant skills
Deep understanding of statistical modeling, machine learning, deep learning, or data mining concepts, and a track record of solving problems with these methods.
Proficient in one or more programming languages such as Python, Scala, Java and C
Familiar with one or more machine learning or statistical modeling tools such as R, Matlab and scikit learn
Knowledge and experience of working with relational databases and SQL
Strong analytical and quantitative problem-solving ability.
Excellent communication, relationship skills and a strong team player.

About Adobe

Adobe empowers everyone to create through innovative platforms and tools that unleash creativity, productivity and personalized customer experiences. Adobe’s industry-leading offerings including Adobe Acrobat Studio, Adobe Express, Adobe Firefly, Creative Cloud, Adobe Experience Platform, Adobe Experience Manager, and GenStudio enable people and businesses to turn ideas into impact, powered by AI and driven by human ingenuity.

Our 30,000+ employees worldwide are creating the future and raising the bar as we drive the next decade of growth. We’re on a mission to hire the very best and believe in creating a company culture where all employees are empowered to make an impact. At Adobe, we believe that great ideas can come from anywhere in the organization. The next big idea could be yours.

Let’s Adobe together

At Adobe, we believe in creating a company culture where all employees are empowered to make an impact. Learn more about Adobe life, including our values and culture, focus on people, purpose and community, Adobe for All, comprehensive benefits programs, the stories we tell, the customers we serve, and how you can help us advance our mission of empowering everyone to create.

Adobe is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based on gender, race or color, ethnicity or national origin, age, disability, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic. Learn more.

Adobe aims to make our Careers website and recruiting process accessible to any and all users. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation to navigate our website or complete the application process, email accommodations@adobe.com.

added.title: Frontend Software Engineer - Frameworks & Dev Platforms
added.description:
Innovate in Charlotte

Thank you for dedicating your time and talent to Lowe’s. We want to give you more opportunities to learn and grow, so if you find a position you’re interested in below, we encourage you to apply!

Your Impact

Build the frontend platforms and frameworks that help engineering teams across Lowe’s build better products, faster.

As a Software Engineer on the Frameworks team, you’ll work on platforms helping shape the tools and capabilities used by product teams across the enterprise. Your work will include building React components, improving framework capabilities and developer tooling, supporting micro-frontend capabilities, improving performance, and contributing to platform modernization.

You’ll take meaningful features from idea to delivery, solve real engineering problems, and help make the development experience better for teams across Lowe’s.

What You Will Do

Build and enhance frontend frameworks, developer platforms, and tooling used by engineering teams across Lowe’s.
Develop React-based components and capabilities using modern JavaScript and frontend engineering practices.
Contribute to framework capabilities, micro-frontend architecture, developer tooling, performance improvements, and platform modernization.
Own medium-sized features and enhancements end-to-end, from understanding requirements through implementation, testing, and delivery.
Troubleshoot production and framework issues, identify root causes, and implement reliable solutions.
Write clean, maintainable code and automated tests while participating in code reviews and established engineering practices.
Work with CI/CD, observability, and other enterprise development tools and practices as part of the software delivery lifecycle.
Collaborate with engineers and cross-functional partners to understand problems, evaluate solutions, and deliver improvements.
Research and learn new technologies and approaches while contributing to a modern frontend engineering environment.

Minimum Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent years of experience in lieu of the education requirement, if applicable.
2 years of experience in software development or a related field.
Hands-on experience building software with React and JavaScript.
Strong understanding of frontend development fundamentals, including component-based development, debugging, testing, and writing maintainable code.
Experience working through the software development lifecycle in an iterative Agile environment.
Ability to take ownership of medium-sized features and enhancements, work through technical problems, and deliver with limited guidance.
Working knowledge of modern software engineering practices, including source control, CI/CD, testing, and secure development.
Ability to learn new technologies and frameworks and apply them to practical engineering problems.

It's a plus if you have:

Experience with TypeScript.
Working knowledge of Node.js or other backend technologies.
Experience with micro-frontends, frontend frameworks, developer tooling, or platform engineering.
Experience with npm, package management, dependency management, or building reusable frontend components and libraries.
Experience with performance optimization, observability, or enterprise-scale applications.
Experience writing technical documentation and working with business or enterprise systems.

Why Join Us?

Impactful Work: Shape the future of Order Management by building critical services that directly impact customer experience.
Growth Opportunities: Continuous learning with the latest tech trends and opportunities to explore new tools and frameworks.
Collaborative Environment: Work with smart, passionate people in a culture that values collaboration, inclusiveness, and innovation.

401k with up to 4.25% match
Discounted Employee Stock Purchase Plan (15% discount of strike price)
Tuition-Free Education

10% Associate Discount

added.title: Flight Software Engineer II
added.description:
Application Close Date

Applications will be accepted on an ongoing basis until the requisition is closed.

At Blue Origin, we envision millions of people living and working in space for the benefit of Earth. We’re working to develop reusable, safe, and low-cost space vehicles and systems within a culture of safety, collaboration, and inclusion. Join our team of problem solvers as we add new chapters to the history of spaceflight! 

This role is part of Blue National Security (BNS), where our focus is the design, development, and delivery of launch and spacecraft systems for national security missions. Through Blue Ring, our all-in-one, high-powered hybrid solar-electric and chemical-propelled spacecraft, we provide unmatched mission maneuverability, versatility, and capacity at dramatically lower-profile costs.

About The Role

Multi-Mission, Multi-Orbit Space Mobility.
Blue Ring is a high-powered hybrid solar-electric and chemical propulsion spacecraft that maneuvers, hosts, and deploys payloads across Earth orbits, the Moon, Mars, interplanetary space, and near-Earth asteroids. It supports science, commercial, and defense missions, and provides hosted payloads with communications, power, data storage, and computing services.

Blue Ring isn't a one-off spacecraft. It's a platform other missions are built on, such as the Mars Telecommunications Orbiter. Our flight software is built the same way: a reusable, configurable product line that evolves with every vehicle we deliver and supports multiple missions from integration and test through on-orbit operations.

That makes this a long-term team. You won't write code for one launch and move on. You'll grow with the platform, carry lessons from each vehicle into the next, and help shape the software that flies on all of them.

As a Flight Software Engineer II, you'll take growing ownership of flight software features that don't retire after one launch. They become part of a platform that evolves with every vehicle we deliver.

Special Mentions

Security clearance and citizenship Active clearance is highly desired but not required. (TS/SCI with CI poly or upgradable to it)
Export control Applicants for employment at Blue Origin must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e. current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.
Relocation Relocation assistance is available for qualified candidates.
Travel Up to 15% travel to other Blue Origin facilities, test sites, or launch sites may be required.

Responsibilities Include But Are Not Limited To

Design, develop, integrate, and test flight software features and components in C and modern C++ with moderate guidance
Implement software requirements from system and subsystem specifications, maintaining traceability
Develop unit, integration, and automated regression tests, and support software-in-the-loop (SIL) and hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) test development and execution
Develop and maintain Python tooling for test automation and engineering workflows
Debug and resolve software and hardware/software integration issues
Participate in design and code reviews
Collaborate with avionics, systems, and test engineers to define and verify software interfaces
Support peers and incoming engineers with onboarding and technical questions

Minimum Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, or a related STEM field
2+ years of professional experience in embedded or flight software development
Working knowledge of C and modern C++ (C++14 or later) for embedded or real-time systems
Experience with Python for tooling, test automation, or scripting
Experience with Git version control
Must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with flight software for spacecraft, launch vehicles, or other safety- or mission-critical systems
Experience with hardware interfaces and protocols such as ADC, DAC, RS-422, UART, SPI, I2C, and Ethernet
Experience with embedded Linux and Yocto
Exposure to Linux kernel modules or device driver development
Exposure to NASA core Flight System (cFS)
Experience with RTOS (e.g., VxWorks, RTEMS, FreeRTOS)
Experience with HIL/SIL test environments
Familiarity with the systems engineering V-model
Familiarity with software standards such as NPR 7150.2 or equivalent
Experience with issue tracking and agile tools (e.g., Jira) and CI/CD pipelines
Active TS/SCI clearance

Base Pay Range For

VA applicants is $134,961.00 - $188,945.40 CO applicants is $123,714.00 - $173,199.60

Other Site Ranges May Differ

Culture Statement

Don’t meet all desired requirements? Studies have shown that some people are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single desired qualification. At Blue Origin, we are dedicated to building an authentic workplace, so if you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every desired qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

Export Control Regulations

Applicants for employment at Blue Origin must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e. current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

Background Check

Required for all positions: Blue’s Standard Background Check
Required for Certain Job Profiles: Defense Biometric Identification System (DBIDS) background check if at any time the role requires one to be on a military installation
Required for Certain Job Profiles: Drivers who operate Commercial Motor Vehicles with a Gross Vehicle Weight (GVW), Gross Vehicle Weight Rating (GVWR) or combination of power unit and trailer that meets or exceeds 10,001 lbs. and/or transports placardable amounts of hazardous materials by ground in any vehicle on a public road while in commerce, may be subject to additional Federal Motor Carrier Safety Regulations including: Driver Qualification Files, Medical Certification (obtained before onboarding), Road Test, Hours of Service, Drug and Alcohol Testing, vehicle inspection requirements, CDL requirements (if applicable) and hazardous materials transportation/shipping training.
Required for certain Job Profiles: Ability to obtain and maintain Merchant Mariner Credential, which includes pre-employment and random drug testing as well as DOT physical

Benefits

Benefits include: Medical, dental, vision, basic and supplemental life insurance, paid parental leave, short and long-term disability, 401(k) with a company match of up to 5%, and an Education Support Program.
Stock Options for all regular employees (working at least 20 hours/week)
Paid Time Off: Up to four (4) weeks per year based on weekly scheduled hours, and up to 14 company-paid holidays.
Dependent on role type and job level, employees may be eligible for benefits and bonuses based on the company's intent to reward individual contributions and enable them to share in the company's results, or other factors at the company's sole discretion. Bonus amounts and eligibility are not guaranteed and subject to change and cancellation. Please check with your recruiter for more details.

Equal Employment Opportunity

Blue Origin is proud to be an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action Employer and is committed to attracting, retaining, and developing a highly qualified and dedicated work force. Blue Origin hires and promotes people on the basis of their qualifications, performance, and abilities. We support the establishment and maintenance of a workplace that fosters trust, equality, and teamwork. We provide all qualified applicants for employment and employees with equal opportunities for hire, promotion, and other terms and conditions of employment, regardless of their race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin/ethnicity, age, physical or mental disability, genetic factors, military/veteran status, or any other status or characteristic protected by federal, state, and/or local law. Blue Origin will consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with applicable federal, state, and local laws, including the Washington Fair Chance Act, the California Fair Chance Act, the Los Angeles Fair Chance in Hiring Ordinance, and other applicable laws. For more information on “Know Your Rights,” please see here.

Applicants wishing to receive information on Blue Origin’s Affirmative Action Plans, or applicants requiring a reasonable accommodation in order to participate in the application and/or interview process, please contact us at EEOCompliance@blueorigin.com. added.title: Fab Automation and Software Engineer
added.description:
A career at TSMC Arizona offers an unparalleled opportunity to contribute to the most advanced semiconductor fabrication facility in the United States. TSMC Arizona's first fab began production with leading-edge N4 process technology in the first half of 2025. The second and third fabs, utilizing even more advanced process technology, will start production by 2028-2030. America's leading technology companies will rely on TSMC Arizona for the next generations of chips that will power the digital future.

Job Summary

As a Fab Automation and Software Engineer, you will design, develop, and optimize complex algorithms to efficiently manage/support manufacturing and allocate resources, tasks, or routes within various systems. CIM engineers aim to automate factory production, minimizing human intervention. This involves developing dashboards, assigning production tasks, and implementing automation solutions. They utilize diverse tools, computer technologies, and algorithms to streamline operations and enhance efficiency.

Essential Functions

Server maintenance and related setting supports, including routine upgrade, troubleshooting with AP teams and virtual machines solutions etc.
Coordinate the project for system enhancement and communicate requirement with users.
Support application migration and participate in technical training from headquarters.

Required Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree or above in Computer Science, Industrial Engineering, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
Strong programming and software engineering skills, including experience with data pipelines, APIs, automated testing, and performance optimization.
Strong applied expertise in one or more areas such as computer vision, anomaly detection, predictive analytics, optimization algorithm, or scheduling, with the ability to guide work across adjacent domains.

Preferred Qualifications

Familiarity in programming languages such as C/C++/C#, Java, Python, HTML5, SQL, VBA.
Excellent collaboration & communication skills, both verbal and written, across different levels and functions of organization
Experience and skill in operation algorithms and A.I. is a plus.
Experience and skill in system infrastructure architecture is a plus e.g., VMWare, Linux/MS solution, Nginx, K8S/Docker etc.
Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite with ability to use a computer, keyboard mouse and other standard office equipment
Strong interpersonal skills to establish trust and maintain productive working relationships
Team-orientation and growth mindset to take on new responsibilities and share workload

Physical Requirements:
[JJ2]

Primarily an office-based role requiring the ability to sit for extended periods of time while working at a computer.
Ability to use a computer, keyboard mouse and other standard office equipment for prolonged periods of time.
Ability to occasionally stand, walk, reach, bend, and carry light objects.

Application Consideration Consent

Paid Time-Off Programs and Holidays: Recharge and spend quality time with loved ones.

added.title: Software Engineer II
added.description:
We Are Allmand, a Generac Company.

For more than 85 years, we've worked alongside our customers to provide the most reliable and rugged light, heat, power and air products to the rental, construction, special event, mining and oil and gas markets - so our customers can keep your promise of a job well done.

With your success in mind, Allmand jobsite equipment is renowned for providing the lowest cost of ownership - delivering superior serviceability, ease of use, durable construction and industry-leading resale value.

We believe power is a promise, a shared commitment to be there for others when it matters most.

For more than 65 years, we’ve turned big ideas into solutions that help protect homes, strengthen businesses, and build a more resilient, efficient, sustainable energy future.

Ready to Power a Smarter World with us?

The Software Engineer II
will develop, enhance, and maintain software supporting embedded controls, power-generation systems, and connected applications. This role combines hands-on software development with an understanding of control systems, helping integrate embedded and server-based technologies used to monitor and control equipment. The successful candidate will contribute to new features, existing system improvements, and scalable software solutions that support evolving product and business needs.

The ideal candidate brings practical software development experience, an interest in control systems, and the initiative to identify opportunities for improvement. Working closely with engineering and cross-functional teams, this individual will evaluate existing controller platforms, gather feedback on system performance and functionality, recommend modifications, and help develop implementation plans. Success in this role requires sound technical judgment, a willingness to ask questions, and the ability to take ownership of assignments while collaborating with others.

Minimum Qualifications

Bachelor of Science degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related discipline.
Three years of relevant professional experience developing, testing, or maintaining software applications, preferably involving embedded systems, industrial controls, connected applications, or related technologies.
Experience with software development, troubleshooting, and debugging in a professional or project-based environment.
Ability to evaluate technical requirements, contribute to software design decisions, and develop maintainable, reliable solutions.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, initiative, and the ability to work independently while collaborating effectively across teams.
Ability to travel less than 10%.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Angular, and C in Linux-based environments.
Experience developing or modifying software for embedded systems, industrial controls, or power-generation equipment.
Familiarity with Deep Sea Electronics (DSE) controllers or comparable control-system platforms.
Working knowledge of control-system architecture, controller functionality, and software configuration or modification.
Experience integrating embedded software with server-based applications, web services, or application programming interfaces (APIs).
Experience developing and maintaining web or mobile applications, including enhancements, troubleshooting, and defect resolution.
Familiarity with software design patterns, application scalability, system interoperability, and maintainable code.
Experience participating in Agile development, collaborative design reviews, and technical planning.

Essential Duties

Develop, test, and maintain software features and functionality using appropriate programming languages, frameworks, and development tools.
Contribute to integrated software solutions that use embedded and server-based systems to monitor and control power-generation equipment.
Develop new applications, enhancements, and fixes for existing web and mobile applications while following established coding standards and best practices.
Evaluate existing controller platforms and control-system architecture to understand system capabilities, identify potential modifications, and recommend improvements.
Gather feedback from engineering and other stakeholders regarding current system functionality, performance, and opportunities for improvement; help develop and implement plans to address identified needs.
Evaluate technical approaches and contribute to selecting cost-effective solutions that balance performance, scalability, maintainability, and business requirements.
Develop and maintain application designs, APIs, user specifications, and technical documentation to support product requirements and interoperability with internal and external systems.
Collaborate with engineering and other cross-functional teams to troubleshoot issues, resolve software defects, and improve system reliability and functionality.
Participate in collaborative design sessions, Agile planning, and retrospective meetings while staying current with emerging technologies and software development best practices.
Take ownership of assigned work, exercise sound technical judgment, communicate challenges, and proactively seek clarification when requirements or system behavior are unclear.

Work Environment and Location

This position is preferably based at the Allmand facility in Holdrege, Nebraska. Candidates based near an approved engineering location in Wisconsin or Colorado may also be considered depending on business needs. Relocation may be available.

The role requires regular collaboration with production and operations teams and may include time spent on the manufacturing floor. Travel is expected to be less than 10%.

added.description:
Our Deloitte AI & Engineering team works to transform technology platforms, drive innovation, and help make a significant impact on our clients' success. You'll work alongside talented professionals reimagining and reengineering operations and processes that are critical to businesses. Your contributions can help clients improve financial performance, accelerate new digital ventures, and fuel growth through innovation.

Work you'll do

As a PROJECT - Data Engineer II on the GPS AI & Data team, you will be responsible for...

Design, build, test, and maintain batch and streaming data pipelines that support analytics, reporting, and artificial intelligence use cases
Develop and optimize data ingestion, transformation, and storage solutions using cloud-based platforms and engineering tools
Implement data models, data quality controls, and monitoring processes to improve accuracy, reliability, and performance
Collaborate with analysts, architects, developers, and client stakeholders to translate business and technical requirements into data solutions
Support deployment, documentation, defect resolution, and ongoing enhancement of data products and platform components

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
Effective written and verbal communication skills
Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
Ability to lead projects or workstreams
Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
Ability to meet deadlines
Ability to provide clear guidance to others

The team

Deloitte's Government & Public Services (GPS) practice - our people, ideas, technology and outcomes - is designed for impact. Serving federal, state, & local government clients as well as public higher education institutions, our team of professionals brings fresh perspective to help clients anticipate disruption, reimagine the possible, and fulfill their mission promise.

Our AI & Data offering provides a full spectrum of solutions for designing, developing, and operating cutting-edge Data and AI platforms, products, insights, and services. Our offerings help clients innovate, enhance and operate their data, AI, and analytics capabilities, ensuring they can mature and scale effectively.

The Project Delivery Talent Model is designed for professionals with specialized skills that align to a current client need. Team members focus on delivering services to clients, without additional expectations related to business development or promotion. Their employment is tied to their role on a project, and they are eligible for a benefits package that is competitive for project delivery-focused professionals.

Qualifications

Required:

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Mathematics, Data Science, or a technical field
1+ years of experience developing Power Apps solutions and 1+ years of experience using SQL and Python
1+ years of experience with data visualization and data mining
Must be eligible to obtain and maintain a Secret security clearance
Ability to travel 0-10%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.
Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future.

Preferred:

Experience with backend application development
Experience with database design and development
Experience with workflow automation
Experience with system integrations
Experience enabling dashboards and reporting solutions
Experience translating requirements into technical solutions, collaborating with stakeholders, and supporting technical documentation and testing

The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $71,300 to $140,600.

You may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance.

Job Category

Job Details

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

We are hiring a Member of Technical Staff to build and operate the automation that keeps third-party and open-source dependencies across a large service fleet patched, auditable, and shipped on time. You will own feature-level work on the pipelines that discover vulnerable packages, decide what to upgrade, open fix PRs across many repositories, and track those fixes through to deployed production artifacts.

This role is pitched at engineers who are strong in pipeline and automation work and are ready to grow into software supply chain security as the problem domain — not at supply chain specialists who code on the side. We will teach you the standards (CVE, CVSS, SBOM, SLSA, Sigstore) if you bring the engineering fundamentals.

Responsibilities

Pipeline Development & Operations

Contribute to data pipelines that ingest vulnerability data, dependency manifests, SBOM artifacts, and deployment metadata into a queryable analytics store.
Build and maintain batch and streaming jobs with idempotent steps, retries, and clear failure modes.
Operate what you ship: on-call for the pipelines you own, debug production failures, and reduce toil through automation.

Repository-wide Automation

Build scripts and small services that interact with many repositories at once — opening PRs, parsing diffs, reading CI feedback, and reconciling the results back into a central store.
Author and maintain CI/CD pipelines with automated test coverage so remediation PRs can be reviewed and merged with confidence.
Resolve attribution issues at the source rather than patching symptoms downstream.

Collaboration & Communication

Partner with service owners to land dependency upgrades, triage breakage, and raise the quality of generated fix PRs.
Translate noisy scanner output into prioritized, actionable work for engineering teams.
Write clear design docs, runbooks, and PR descriptions; keep documentation current when behavior changes.

Quality & Growth

Write Python and Java code that matches the conventions of the existing codebase and holds up under review.
Add regression tests for every bug you fix; treat failing tests as signal rather than noise.
Learn the supply chain domain on the job — vulnerability lifecycle, dependency resolution, artifact provenance — and bring that knowledge back into the pipelines you build.

Required Skills / Experience

Industry Experience: 3+ years in software engineering with strong proficiency in Python and Java, and reading-fluency in at least two of Node.js, Go, and Ruby.

At PitchBook, a Morningstar company, we are always looking forward. We continue to innovate, evolve, and invest in ourselves to bring out the best in everyone. We’re deeply collaborative and thrive on the excitement, energy, and fun that reverberates throughout the company.

Our extensive learning programs and mentorship opportunities help us create a culture of curiosity that pushes us to always find new solutions and better ways of doing things. The combination of a rapidly evolving industry and our high ambitions means there’s going to be some ambiguity along the way, but we excel when we challenge ourselves. We’re willing to take risks, fail fast, and do it all over again in the pursuit of excellence.

If you have a good attitude and are willing to roll up your sleeves to get things done, PitchBook is the place for you.

About The Role

As a member of the Product and Engineering team at PitchBook, you will be part of a team of big thinkers, innovators, and problem solvers who strive to deepen the positive impact we have on our customers and our company every day. We value curiosity and the drive to find better ways of doing things. We thrive on customer empathy, which remains our focus when creating excellent customer experiences through product innovation.

We know that greatness is achieved through collaboration and diverse points of view, so we work closely with partners around the globe. As a team, we assume positive intent in each other’s words and actions, value constructive discussions, and foster a respectful working environment built on integrity, growth, and business value. We invest heavily in our people, who are eager to learn and constantly improve. Join our team and grow with us!

As a Machine Learning Engineer (MLE) on the AI & ML (Insights) team, you will play a critical role in delivering AI-powered features that extract meaningful insights from PitchBook’s wealth of structured and unstructured data, including reports, news, and other textual content. This role requires deep technical expertise in advanced data analytics and machine learning, as well as a hands-on approach to designing, building, and optimizing ML solutions that power user-facing features on the PitchBook Platform.

You will be deeply involved in the end-to-end development and operationalization of ML models, including their architecture, training, deployment, and ongoing maintenance. Your focus will span across natural language processing (NLP), generative AI (GenAI), large language models (LLMs), and scalable data systems. You will be expected to tackle complex technical challenges, contribute to architectural decisions, and collaborate closely with other engineers, data scientists, and product managers to ensure that your work aligns with business goals and AI/ML strategy.

Your contributions will help unlock unique value for PitchBook customers by improving the speed, discoverability, quality, and quantity of insights available on the platform. This includes developing models that can infer meaning and structure from millions of discrete data sources and applying ML to enrich our datasets with predictive and generative intelligence.

Primary Job Responsibilities

Deliver high-impact AI and ML capabilities that drive insight generation on the PitchBook Platform. Ensure your work contributes to broader business goals and is aligned with the team's strategic priorities
Provide hands-on expertise in designing, building, and deploying AI/ML models and services with a focus on NLP, summarization, semantic search, classification, and prediction. Contribute to the development of scalable, high-performance systems that meet production-grade reliability and efficiency standards
Contribute to a culture of technical excellence by sharing knowledge, pairing with teammates, and actively participating in code and design reviews. Provide situational guidance to junior engineers and contribute to team best practices
Build and optimize models that leverage classifiers, transformers, LLMs, and other NLP techniques to generate meaningful insights from structured and unstructured data. Integrate these models into the broader AI/ML infrastructure in collaboration with partner teams
Collaborate with engineering, product management, and data collection teams to ensure models are informed by high-quality data and support strategic product goals
Explore and experiment with emerging technologies, methodologies, and tools in the fields of GenAI, NLP, and search. Translate research findings into practical solutions that enhance PitchBook’s AI capabilities
Contribute to best practices in model transparency, monitoring, evaluation, and compliance. Help maintain high standards of security, data integrity, and responsible AI use across your projects
Participate in the technical evaluation of candidates and help onboard new team members by contributing to documentation, pairing, and knowledge-sharing practices
Apply principles from Agile, Lean, and Fast-Flow methodologies to support efficient model development and deployment cycles
Support the vision and values of the company through role modeling and encouraging desired behaviors
Participate in various company initiatives and projects as requested

Basic Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, or Data Science
2+ years of experience in software engineering or machine learning engineering, with a strong focus on AI/ML applications in insight generation, summarization, semantic search, and prediction
Must be authorized to work in the United States without the need for visa sponsorship now or in the future

Preferred Qualifications

Demonstrated expertise in natural language processing (NLP) and machine learning, including hands-on experience with classifiers, transformer models, large language models (LLMs), and widely used ML and data science libraries such as scikit-learn, pandas, NumPy, TensorFlow, and PyTorch
Experience delivering production-grade GenAI or LLM-based systems with measurable business impact
Familiarity with the LangChain ecosystem, including tools such as LangSmith and LangGraph, and experience using them in production environments is a strong plus
Proficiency in building and maintaining scalable data pipelines and distributed systems using technologies such as Apache Kafka, Airflow, and cloud data platforms like Snowflake
Strong programming skills in Python and SQL, with working knowledge of additional languages such as Java or Scala considered a plus
Practical experience with cloud-native development, containerization, and orchestration technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes
Demonstrated ability to solve complex technical problems, contribute to architectural decisions, and deliver high-performance, reliable solutions
Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with experience working cross-functionally with product managers, engineers, and data scientists in globally distributed teams
Experience working in fast-paced, data-driven environments. Prior exposure to fintech or financial data platforms is a strong advantage
Experience authoring research papers for peer-reviewed AI/ML conferences (e.g., NeurIPS, ICML, ACL) and participating in the broader AI research community is strongly preferred

Comprehensive health benefits
Additional medical wellness incentives
STD, LTD, AD&D, and life insurance

Paid sabbatical program after four years

Robust training programs on industry and soft skills
Employee assistance program

Employee resource groups

Dependent Care FSA
Company-wide events
Employee referral bonus program
Quarterly team building events

Financial Health

401k match

Monthly transportation stipend
Please be aware the above PitchBook benefit and perk offerings are subject to corresponding plan and policy documents and may change during the course of your employment.

Target annual bonus percentage: 10%

At the heart of our company is a belief in the power of in-person collaboration. Being together in the office fuels our creativity, strengthens our connections, and drives the innovation that sets us apart. Our culture is built on spontaneous moments—those hallway conversations, whiteboard brainstorms, and shared celebrations in each of our global offices—that simply can’t be replicated remotely. in our Advanced Chip Engineering (ACE) organization, you will work in a dynamic environment to explore methodology, flows and tools to improve efficiency and quality of results (power, performance, area, and quality) for SoC and IP development teams across the organization. Explore research ideas and solutions that bring AI/ML applications to VLSI design
Work closely with Academic research communities in AI/ML for VLSI design, Architecture teams, IP and SoC designers and SoC Implementation teams from multiple sites to explore and evaluate for leading edge SoC technologies serving multiple industries
These automation applications include use of GenAI, Reinforcement Learning, Graph Neural Networks, and convolutional Networks
Strong AI/ML expertise, software and CAD background required

5+ years of experience in AI and ML techniques (LLMs, CNN, RNN, and GraphNN) with experience of application to real world optimization problems

Excellent analytical problem-solving skills
Strong verbal and written communication skills
